intuition: Distance comparisons need only squared Euclidean distance, avoiding square roots.

brute_force.approach: Sort all points by squared distance and return the first k.

optimal.approach: Keep a max-heap of the k smallest squared distances, replacing its farthest point when a closer point arrives.

edge_cases: A point at the origin has distance zero.
Several points may tie at the kth distance, and any valid k points may be returned.
